messages:
maria: Morning team — quick situational awareness thread. Noticed the warmup pool in eu-west has been stuck at 75% queue for ~30m. Any config changes overnight?
ajay: no intentional changes from infra side. I saw a couple of spot interruptions in eu-west-2 around 02:10 UTC, might be related.
tess: saw the same, logs show repeated allocation retries: `alloc_controller: backoff retry=3 reason=InsufficientCapacity`. Can share the trace.
liam: looking at autoscaler metrics now — scaling decisions are firing but the instance launch time spiked (avg 180s -> 420s) between 02:05-02:25. Suspect noisy host AZ-level consolidation.
maria: thanks — can we confirm if fallback routing to us-west was triggered? We want graceful degradation rather than queue growth.
ajay: fallback policy did kick once for a small subset (model=redwood-7b-q4). Routing logs: `route: fallback -> us-west-1 for 12 reqs`. Didn't fully drain the queue though.
sre-bot: Alert: warmup_pool_queue > 70% for 31 minutes (eu-west). Threshold: 60%.
tess: I've queued a repro run on a canary cluster to reproduce allocation spike, attaching job id `canary-3487`. If it reproduces, we'll test prewarmed AMI patch.
liam: quick note — the capacity headroom dashboard shows reserved buffer of 20% for eu-west but effective usable headroom dropped to 8% because of ongoing spot evictions. Might need to temporarily increase reserved capacity or enable more cross-region overflow.
maria: prefer cross-region overflow first — ajay can you open a small change to broaden routing policy to accept eu-west -> eu-central overflow for non-latency-sensitive routes?
ajay: will do, opening PR now and tagging ops. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/routing/PR-2124 : changeset broadens fallback for queueing models.
tess: FYI, the canary repro failed to trigger the long launch times on fresh m5 instances, so it's likely limited to the spot pool.
liam: propose short-term mitigation: 1) enable overflow to eu-central 2) bump warmup pool target by +15% for next 2 hours 3) monitor for 1 hour, rollback if cost spike.
maria: sounds good. ajay/tess please coordinate rollout. I'll post an update to the oncall channel once overflow is live.
ajay: overflow enabled at 03:14 UTC, routing logs show reroutes starting at 03:16.
sre-bot: Info: fallback routing active eu-west -> eu-central at 2026-03-17T03:16:05Z.
tess: warmup queue down to 34% after overflow, launch times normalized. Leaving the bump for 30m then reevaluate.
maria: great — nothing else from me. If anyone sees the queue creeping again ping me and we'll escalate to reserved capacity requests. :thumbsup:
liam: noted. adding a follow-up ticket to backlog to evaluate spot pool footprint and fallback granularity.
